tables.name: cut_approval_instance

newColumns.lead_time_enabled: BIT(1) NOT NULL NO DEFAULT after migration

checks: lead_time_enabled=b'1' requires grade_code IN ('A','B') and lead_time_snapshot IS NOT NULL
new V2 A/B creation always writes enabled=1; new C/D writes enabled=0
tables.jsonContract: exact LeadTimeCompliance from F-CUT-008-api-contract.json; immutable after insert

tables.name: cut_approval_notification

newColumns.channel_code: VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL NO DEFAULT after migration

checks: IN_PLATFORM uses the existing message_id/SENT semantics and provider_reference_id is null
external channels keep message_id null; ACCEPTED requires provider_reference_id and last_attempt_at
external DELIVERY_UNKNOWN requires last_attempt_at and is not automatically retried
PENDING has no provider result or attempt timestamp

migration.instanceRows: existing rows are deterministically backfilled lead_time_enabled=b'0', lead_time_snapshot remains null; no historical calculation
migration.notificationRows: existing rows are deterministically backfilled channel_code='IN_PLATFORM'; delivery_key,message_id,status,retry/time fields are not rewritten
migration.defaults: temporary defaults used only inside the forward migration are removed before completion; application writes all new fields explicitly
migration.legacy: pms_cut_task/pms_cut_plan are not read, migrated or dual-written

ruleSnapshot.allocation: calculated once inside F-CUT-005 start outer transaction before approval insert; never recomputed in query

notificationStateTransitions.create: initial or next-node activation appends external PENDING rows; current PENDING-node reassignment appends rows for the new recipient/nodeVersion; WAITING-node reassignment appends none until its later activation
notificationStateTransitions.explicitFailure: explicit provider failure, request contract error or Owner data corruption moves PENDING|PENDING_RETRY -> PENDING_RETRY with the same deliveryKey, stable errorCode, incremented retryCount and server retry time
notificationStateTransitions.unknown: PENDING|PENDING_RETRY -> DELIVERY_UNKNOWN; excluded from automatic retry
notificationStateTransitions.approvalIsolation: none of these transitions updates cut_approval_instance/node/task

lockOrder: append external channel rows in channel enum order
delivery Job locks notification rows only after approval transaction commits
hardDependencies: F-CUT-005 approval instance and node activation
controlledPositiveLoop: CUT tests use deterministic ports for all three channels; production providers and job activation are outside this Feature implementation scope
